[[File:Medial icosacronic hexecontahedron.stl|thumb|3D model of a medial icosacronic hexecontahedron]]
In [[geometry]], the '''medial icosacronic hexecontahedron''' (or '''midly sagittal ditriacontahedron''') is a nonconvex [[Isohedral figure|isohedral]] [[polyhedron]]. It is the [[Dual polyhedron|dual]] of the [[uniform star polyhedron|uniform]] [[icosidodecadodecahedron]]. Its faces are darts. Part of each dart lies inside the solid, hence is invisible in solid models.

== Proportions ==
Faces  have two angles of <math>\arccos(\frac{3}{4})\approx 41.409\,622\,109\,27^{\circ}</math>, one of <math>\arccos(-\frac{1}{8}+\frac{7}{24}\sqrt{5})\approx 58.184\,446\,117\,59^{\circ}</math> and one of <math>360^{\circ}-\arccos(-\frac{1}{8}-\frac{7}{24}\sqrt{5})\approx 218.996\,309\,663\,87^{\circ}</math>. Its [[dihedral angles]] equal <math>\arccos(-\frac{5}{7})\approx 135.584\,691\,402\,81^{\circ}</math>. The ratio between the lengths of the long and short edges is <math>\frac{27+7\sqrt{5}}{22}\approx 1.938\,748\,901\,93</math>.
